notes.title: Demo Hotfix is Live
notes.notes: [p]As you may have noticed, Abra-Cooking-Dabra received some updates - but what they are about? It's simple: they bring the following improvements: [/p][list][*][p]Improved coins piling[/p][/*][*][p]Better grid interactions and dragging[/p][/*][*][p]Polished interactions with the trash can[/p][/*][*][p]Added zoom lock for the trash can and refrigerators[/p][/*][*][p]Additional minor fixes and improvements[/p][/*][/list][p] Have a nice time cooking! [/p][p][i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i][/p]
